ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Qutai adds the screenshots and images you choose to save to your photos.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Qutai uses the camera to scan QR codes, to take a photo or video for a web page’s upload field, and for sites you allow to use it, such as video calls.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Qutai uses the microphone when you speak a message to the assistant, for sites you allow to use it, such as video calls, and to record sound when you take a video to upload to a web page.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Qutai turns what you say to the assistant into text. When your speech can’t be recognised on the device itself, Apple’s speech service receives the audio to do this; Qutai and your AI provider only get the text.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Qutai uses Face ID to unlock the app and incognito tabs.
ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Qutai adds events you confirm, such as tickets and reservations, to your calendar, and reads it only when you ask the assistant about your schedule and confirm.
ios.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Qutai reads your calendar only when you ask the assistant about your schedule and confirm, and sends the events in the range you approved to your AI provider.
ios.NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: Qutai adds events you confirm, such as tickets and reservations, to your calendar.
ios.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Qutai adds reminders you confirm to your Reminders.
ios.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Qutai adds reminders you confirm to your Reminders.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Qutai shows your position to the sites you allow, such as maps, and to the assistant when you ask it to use your location.
